method: per-corpus Wilson LB + corpus-stratified cluster bootstrap + leave-one-corpus-out
verdict: Pooled intersection precision 0.995 over n=401 accepted receipts across all three corpora; corpus-stratified cluster bootstrap 95% CI [0.9875, 1.0] and Wilson lower bound 0.982. The weakest single corpus (SROIE) still has a Wilson floor of 0.7961, and dropping ANY corpus (incl. small-n SROIE) leaves the pooled Wilson LB at >=0.9574. The intersection claim does not rest on any one corpus; it strengthens under the standard stratified treatment.
